description: Typing a period in the phone file filter must not navigate away from the picker. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Open Diffs: on a phone it is in the overflow menu: click the button named "More options", then, in its popover (".chat-overflow-popover"), the button whose accessible name starts with "Diffs" (".overflow-toolbar-action[aria-label=\"Diffs\"]"). The ".diff-viewer-overlay" should be visible. Click ".diff-viewer-overlay .commit-picker-trigger"; in ".git-graph-container" click the ".git-graph-row" containing "Working changes". Click the row titled "foo.txt" in ".diff-rethink-mobile-files", then click ".diff-rethink-file-jump". The dialog "Choose file" is visible. Fill its textbox "Filter files" with "foo", then focus that textbox and press the period key. Its value is "foo."; the picker remains visible and has the row "foo.txt" but not "fooXtxt".
